reviews.text: Had a really good experience here. They did a great job grooming our doggie and she looked great when we picked her up. Everyone was friendly and it seemed like she was well looked after while she was there. Very happy with the whole experience and we’ll definitely be back!
Thank you, Jemma!

Absolutely loved the way Milo was groomed. Well looked after from start to finish, you can even see through the window how your pet is being handled. Although I have to add the groomers should pay a little bit more attention to his ears being dry as he did get a mild ear infection from them not being fully dry , but nothing too serious. For the rest of the groom I was fully happy with the result
Movie star dog!
Bichon Frise was back for his 3rd groom - both he and his human are very happy and will be back again - superb groom, great staff

We have been using Grooming.dog for a long time. Unfortunately, this time I did not have a good experience. My dog’s fur was  uneven in certain areas, as the groomer did not pay attention while cutting the fur. I was informed about this error in relation to a specific area of the fur after the payment, just before I collected my dog. When I left, I noticed other areas near the legs. I would have expected more accuracy from an establishment that promotes luxury dog services.

I can not recommend the daycare. First of all the girl at the reception charged me the price for half day (35€) even though my dog was there for less than two hours (which costs 20€ according to their website). She also lied about my dog having a great time. I kept watching the live webcam and my dog was standing in a corner alone the whole time.

Outstanding service, very friendly staff!
They took very good care of my dog for her first grooming and she was a new dog after her pampering session!

I was asked about her behavior, our preferences and the whole session took over 3 hours!! I was told they wanted to take their time to make sure my dog was relaxed and that everything was done right - and I couldn't be happier!!

You folks are AWESOME!
The team is super friendly and gentle and the haircut turned out exactly as we discussed prior to the appointment! I would 100% recommend and come back any time! 🐾 …
Best dog grooming in Dublin. They do such a good job and are very friendly to me and my dog! Couldn’t recommend more
Very friendly and professional 😎 …

We absolutely love this Grooming Dog- and more importantly, so does Otis, our black cocker spaniel! He literally waits at the door to be let in, which says everything you need to know. He comes out looking gloriously fluffy and absolutely delighted with himself every single time.

What really impresses us is that no matter what Otis has been up to beforehand - including the occasional swim in the river! - the team always works their magic and sends him home looking immaculate. We wouldn’t take him anywhere else. Highly recommend! 🐾
It was Stella’s first groom and the staff were lovely and made it a really easy experience for both myself and Stella
Bobby was looked after so well - he is nearly 14 but they gave him such great care and he looks great
Best dog groomers !
Our dog came out looking absolutely fabulous: thank you! ❤️
Super
my pug/shih-tzu cross Winnie looks so pretty! Thank you grooming.dog!! Very happy!
Excellent service … staff are wonderful and I am always delighted with the standard of the work. The premises are beautiful and my dog is very well taken care of! Would highly recommend.

I’m absolutely delighted with how my Yorkie was groomed. The groomer did an amazing job — he looks beautiful, neat, and clearly felt comfortable the whole time. You can really see the care and attention to detail. Highly recommend this place!

My very bad experience with This Growing , my dog ​​was left behind for about 2 hours in a closed cage, he did let him play as all the dogs do ,is a (Shih Tzu), they also said on the phone that he would be ready in a maximum of 1 hour and a half to 2, my dog ​​was in a cage closed like in prison, bad on their part ! I go inside and ask where he's my dog the kep said 15 minutes and he's out for Grooming,the not mention how long it takes and where the dog stays 3 hours. I do not recommend it very expensive €100 plus €20 for the grils how take care of hem,and very rude and unprofessional service and staff! Thank you !

This place made us wait so much and they holded my dog in the back for 2 hours they havent even cut his hair my dog is super scared and upset I hope he gets better I dont know what they did to my dog I think they dont work with the dogs very nice we didnt have a good experiance...there is very bad service. ... they make fun of dogs and dont treat dogs with respect..
My dog is usually very nervous getting groomed and they did and amazing job.
Our dog was very happy and smart after the grooming
Always a pleasant experience at Grooming.Dog both in the efficient booking process and the groom itself………our boy always comes out looking super handsome 🫶 …

This a great place! Our dog nearly tears my arm trying to get through the door when we arrive. When we tell him he’s going to see his friends he lights up. The staff are so friendly and helpful, and I couldn’t recommend the place more.
Fantastic experience from start to finish.
Perfect job as always!

I brought my dog to grooming.dog for the first time, and I am very satisfied with the service. We received a very warm welcome on arrival. The groomer came out to speak with me, discussed my preferences for the cut, and kindly suggested a style suitable for my dog’s breed.

The grooming was done to a very high standard — the cut is precise and beautifully finished. The style turned out exactly as requested and perfectly suited my dog’s breed.

Thank you very much to the entire team. I highly recommend Grooming.Dog and will definitely be bringing my dog back for her next grooming session.
Tried many groomers as my dog so nervous.. Grooming Dog are so professional friendly and caring with the dogs !  AMAZING SERVICE can’t say enough xx thank you guys ♥️

The Grooming.Dog staff were faultless to a tee – super helpful from the first point of contact, knowledgable and caring in that they understood how to manage our 5-month old puppy’s needs for her first grooming session, and lovely and professional in equal manner from the moment I dropped our puppy off until I collected her. The service and expertise were clearly on display and our puppy went from looking like a grunge rock groupie to a gorgeous girlie in one go. Thanks to all the team from Pebbles & Co. Much appreciated all round.
Great!  Our dog was well taken of and it's a lovely place!
Parker is happy - so I am happy!
Such lovely staff, very patient with George
The best around! So caring and kind and an amazing job done! Thank you so much ❤️❤️
They took care of two dogs wonderfully.
Wonderful service. My dog was happy, relaxed, and looked great. Highly recommended!”
Excellent service  staff so helpful  would recommend  bringing  your  dog  there

Grooming dog this place I wouldn’t bring our dog go there
Today we bring our little dog to cut her nails short ,

It’s very unforgettable Experience with this place ,
They are not generally love the pets , pulling the little  one hardly  hurt her neck , dog got  scared After immediately,  of course our dog naturally receive  very bad vibes from those people working in his place ..
the place filthy  dirty hairs everywhere  not even say 1% hygiene . It’s a No, and  Definitely would not recommended for anyone who truly loved their dog 🐶 to visit this place or put your dogs day care in this place
Definitely not the right place to go for your pets
Great. They did a fantastic job with our 2 Irish Setters.
Always happy!!!

We brought our 2 corgi’s Milo and Jake to dog grooming for the first time, we were absolutely delighted with the results, the dogs were so relaxed after the grooming, staff are very professional, we were very happy with the results, and would definitely recommend dog grooming, we will be back, thank you guys 😊 …
We had a wonderful experience. Our bernadoodle came out looking gorgeous and very settled.
I brought my little puppy for her first groom today with grooming dog! They were absolutely amazing the girls were so lovely and reassuring. She looks absolutely gorgeous

Great service
Dog went in a scruff ball and came out looking fabulous 😀
They do a great job here …
Excellent
My dog is happy and well groomed when we bring her there for a bath and cut. The staff is lovely and always very kind to the pets which is exactly what you want when you are handling your pet over.
Bonnie loves getting her hair done here 🐩 - the best service and such lovely friendly staff! …
The best around. Gemmas the only groomer my dog is comfortable around! 10/10
Best grooming service, and they always manage to fit me in at short notice.
Fantastic place for your four legged friend! We use Grooming.dog for pet daycare services, and our pup adores going in. Kind and caring staff, would recommend

Freya enjoyed getting groomed today, she confidently went in with the staff and came out with a wagging tail. We got many compliments on our walk of how great and shiny her coat is.
Bonus, you get to watch your dog from outside.
I am 100% satisfied with the service. My dog has never looked better being groomed here in Dublin as all my requests were taken into consideration so I can highly recommend it
Outstanding. First groom for my pup and they are amazing. Couldn’t recommend highly enough.

Dermot and the team here are brilliant. I’ve a v nervous senior golden who is treated so well and taken such good care of. Always put my worries to ease handing her over to Dermot. And of course she always comes back looking so clean and well groomed. Couldn’t recommend highly enough.

Always so happy
👍 …
Our dog Luna always runs head first into grooming.dog and leaves looking great. Delighted with the service.
Excellent service. My first visit. Very impressed with quality of grooming and the uber friendliness of the staff. I shall return again.

Always a wonderful experience, coming here from the start with our 3 year old Shih tzu Cookie and he’s always happy and excited for his appointments, always leaving looking gorgeous. Very professional team always feel welcome😊 …
Wilfie my Golden Retriever is a very anxious dog, this was his first groom. Fiona his groomer and the team were all friendly and professional. A lovely salon my boy looks brand new… 🙌 …
Ted is looking great as usual after his  express bath and blow dry
As always, Friendly convenient and my dog happily walks off-lead up to the front door and into the salon, what more can you ask for.   Dermot is excellent
Really pleased with the groom.  My dog looks beautiful.  The staff are so friendly and treat the dogs so well.
It's very good. Front desk staff very nice and groomers also. They seem to have a way with dogs big and small. Pic of Max after haircut. He appears happy enough.
Charlie had his first  visit today at grooming.dog, they took such good care of him, his cut is beautiful and we’re very happy.
Great grooming . Always delighted with results !
Great service, lovely people!

Lovely grooming milo had his bubbly bath full works and prices are great would recommend also left my dog into daycare the 22/9/25 and he loved it would recommend staff are very nice and milo loved them thank you 😊 …
Our pup looks great and is happy to be home.
The staff are lovely, and our dog not only enjoyed it but also is so soft as a result, fab.
Simply amazing! Our little Pelle, a white Miniature Schnauzer, has never looked so good! Thank you and 1,000 points if you could give them.

We brought our two yorkies (our babies), for their first full groom here a couple years ago. They were both very happy and wagging their tails when we came to collect them and the lovely staff done an amazing job looking after our two babies.

I brought my dad’s deaf dog in for her very first grooming today, and I can’t express how impressed I am. I was nervous at first, but the staff went above and beyond — they treated her with so much patience, kindness, and care, giving her all the extra time and attention she needed. She was truly treated like a queen from start to finish.

When I picked her up, she looked absolutely incredible — so clean, fluffy, and happy, with a haircut that was done to absolute perfection. The transformation was amazing, and you could tell she felt comfortable and confident. We also loved her new heart bandana — such a thoughtful and adorable finishing touch!

I am beyond grateful for the wonderful experience and the way they cared for her. I would give 10 stars if I could and would highly, highly recommend this grooming service to anyone who wants the very best for their dog!
My dog said it was great and she can’t wait to go back
The groomers did a fantastic job — Alfie came back looking great and he’s so happy. The team asked what we wanted and clearly care about the dogs. We’d definitely recommend them!

Teddy really enjoys his grooming appointments and he always comes out looking very handsome.  The staff are attentive and genuinely care and always have practical suggestions in terms of length and style.  Thank you team!
Really friendly groomers, so kind to my dog and you can see your dog getting groomed from the bench outside.
Amazing experience and friendly stuff.

OUTSTANDING in every way! Exceptional staff, attention given to detail, personalized attention, completed and ready on time. I had 100% confidence in leaving my beautiful girl with them and knowing she would receive the treatment requested for her. Absolute perfection. Highly recommend!

I can’t recommend Grooming Dog enough! My dog Tobi absolutely loves spending time at the day care, and he always comes back happy and well looked after. The grooming service is fantastic too, his haircuts are always fresh, stylish, and done with great care. A huge thank you to Dermot and the team for their amazing work. The place is spotless, the service is excellent, and you can really tell they love what they do. Definitely five stars from us!
Dermot

What a service, My first time using Grooming dog, rang them at short notice and were able to fit me in within 24 hours. My dog loved it there and the staff were amazing, can't recommend this groomers enough
Bob came home looking 10 years younger! Great job 😍 …

Our boy Charlee got arguably the best trim cut we have ever had for him from these wonderful folks! As a doodle it can be difficult to get a good cut that he doesn't have to "grow into" and we were very impressed with how good his face cut was. Also, a lot of times after baths and such he can smell like some chemical perfume and that was not the case here. Could not be more satisfied... even if it didn't last too long before he jumped in some water lol
Excellent service and staff, highly recommend they done a beautiful job on my lil ragamuffin 🤣thanks again 😊 …
Lovely experience,our dog looked great,staff were friendly.
Our Miniature Schnauzer looks amazing after his groom. The girls did such a good job and did exactly what we requested. Delighted to have found you.

The team are always so lovely to deal with & are all great with my dog. A soon to be 1 year old Labrador. She’s quite excitable still & the team are brilliant with her. We’ve been a few times now with her for full grooms & nails trim & the service is always great. And nala is always happy out!!! 🤍 …

Outstanding service at grooming.dog from beginning to end!

Dermot has a genuine love for dogs and a real commitment to his clients. He truly went the extra mile to look after us and made the entire process incredibly smooth and stress-free — the level of care and attention to detail was exceptional.

The lady at the reception was also very welcoming and kind, which made the whole experience even more pleasant.

We’re really grateful for the experience and the flexibility — being able to book Benjamin for a full groom on short notice and still be accommodated is such a relief.
